verdict.rationale: A long-time customer reports running dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules, which suggests a native auto top-up capability. However, there is no first-party documentation of auto-transfer rules, and no native low-balance alert feature is documented. The internal-transfer API and balance-change webhooks are developer building blocks for constructing these features, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of auto top-up or auto-funding rules, a native low-balance alert feature with configurable thresholds.
